acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce a normal author/reviewer handoff sequence at one acceptance revision and demonstrate no false RETRY_EXHAUSTED without failed work.
Define and implement spec-bound accounting that distinguishes voluntary handoffs/review from genuine failure or expiry; claim and plan preview agree, and real retry/crash-loop limits remain enforced.

Preserve immutable journal history, acceptance-revision binding, gates, approval and dependency checks, stale generation fencing and read nonmutation; retain regression tests for ordinary handoff, review RETURN, failure-class release, expiry/reap and real exhaustion.
Retain focused verification, independent review, CEM/OCM, ready-for-review PR and genuine integrated native completion/readback/audit.
body:
https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/412
Reported installed main-25971bd VERSION1.0.0-rc.1; external flowproof queue author/review handoffs exhaust MaxRetries3 with no gate failure. Root checked exact public source retained in issue409 clean leaf: internal/tasks/transaction/lease_claim.go221 increments every same-revision prior RetryCount and plan.go216 treats non-COMPLETED RetryCount>=MaxRetries as exhausted. Mechanism confirmed by code; reported external queue reproduction not yet independently run. Related completed V1-0496/#378 is audited OWNER recovery, not automatic failure-versus-handoff accounting. Existing retry and handoff native searches including full tail found no equivalent open ticket. Existing CAL-V0-013 authority must be amended deliberately; no policy changes, automatic reopen, acceptance-revision churn, counter reset, or failed-gate bypass authorized by this intake.
title: GH #412: distinguish voluntary review handoffs from failed-attempt retry accounting
